lines: Tattha acchodikāti acchaṃ abahalaṃ sukhumaṃ udakaṃ etesūti “acchodakā”ti vattabbe liṅgavipallāsena acchodikā”ti vuttaṃ.
Puthusilāti puthulā vitthatā mudusukhasamphassā silā etesūti puthusilā.
Gunnaṃ viya naṅgulaṃ naṅguṭṭhaṃ etesanti gonaṅgulā, kāḷamakkaṭā,“pakatimakkaṭā” tipi vadantiyeva.
Gonaṅgulehi ca pasadādikehi migehi ca tahaṃ tahaṃ vicarantehi āyutā missitāti gonaṅgulamigāyutā.
Ambusevālasañchannāti pasavanato satataṃ paggharamānasalilatāya tahaṃ tahaṃ udakasevālasañchāditā.
te edisā selā pabbatā vivekābhiratiyā maṃ ramayanti, tasmā tatthevāhaṃ gacchāmīti adhippāyo.

before.title: Vanavacchattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Ayampi purimabuddhesu katādhikāro tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭūpanissayaṃ kusalabījaṃ ropento vipassissa bhagavato kāle kulagehe nibbattitvā viññutaṃ patto parassa kammaṃ katvā jīvanto kassaci aparādhaṃ katvā maraṇabhayena tajjito palāyanto antarāmagge bodhirukkhaṃ disvā pasannamānaso tassa mūlaṃ sammajjitvā piṇḍibandhehi asokapupphehi pūjaṃ katvā vanditvā bodhiṃ abhimukho namassamāno pallaṅkena nisinno māretuṃ āgate paccatthike disvā tesu cittaṃ akopetvā bodhiṃ eva āvajjento sataporise papāte papati.

So tena puññakammena devaloke nibbattitvā aparāparaṃ puññāni katvā devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddhuppāde rājagahe vibhavasampannassa brāhmaṇassa putto hutvā nibbatti,“vaccho” tissa nāmaṃ ahosi.
So vayappatto bimbisārasamāgame paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.

before.title: Vanavacchattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Te ca disvānahaṃ tattha, āvajjiṃ bodhimuttamaṃ.

before.title: Vanavacchattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “Ito ca tatiye kappe, rājā susaññato ahaṃ;

before.title: Vanavacchattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: “Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan”ti.

before.title: Vanavacchattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Arahattaṃ pana patvā vivekābhiratiyā vaneyeva vasi, tena vanavacchoti samaññā udapādi.
Atha kadāci thero ñātijanānuggahatthaṃ rājagahaṃ gato tattha ñātakehi upaṭṭhiyamāno katipāhaṃ vasitvā gamanākāraṃ sandasseti.
Taṃ ñātakā,“bhante, amhākaṃ anuggahatthaṃ dhuravihāre vasatha, mayaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmā”ti yāciṃsu.
